name: Sunsoft FME-7 / 5A / 5B family

components.role: FME-7-family ASIC with command/data register interface, banked PRG/CHR outputs, selectable $6000 ROM/RAM window, CIRAM routing and CPU-cycle IRQ counter
Sunsoft 5B chip-internal three-channel tone/noise/envelope PSG and logarithmic DAC state

notes: Mapper 69 file metadata does not identify the exact FME-7/5A/5B ASIC revision, so AxetosOS models the externally compatible mapper family without filename/hash inference. The 5B PSG's tone, noise, envelope, mixer and DAC state are implemented as chip-internal circuitry and clocked from CPU cycles. The current cartridge connector/audio presentation path has no generic analog expansion-audio net yet, so PSG output is diagnostic state rather than host-mixed PCM; adding that transport requires generic physical analog/package-output infrastructure rather than a mapper-specific motherboard shortcut.
